batch: JoeWare UserDump, DNSSrvRec and ELDLLEx source-detail review

sources.versionHistoryObservation: The page also lists Version 2.02.00 - 01/28/2001 with the note 'Added banner'.
sources.behavior: Enumerates user accounts on a specified NT-based machine and emits user ID, password age, expired, disabled, password-not-required, locked and no-expire fields as tab-delimited output.
sources.disposition: Do not resolve the page's Current Version / Version History conflict by inference. Exact ZIP identity and inert archive-content review remain open; never inspect real account data.

sources.productPageObservation: Version 1.00.00 - January 15, 2005; lists Windows 2000, Windows Server 2003 and Windows XP.
sources.usageBehavior: Supports clear, replace, delete and add operations on DNS SRV records. Multiple actions are processed in clear/replace/delete/add order. Usage identifies AddSrvRec V01.00.00cpp, January 2006.
sources.disposition: Product-page year conflicts with the version-list date and usage build label. These are cached official observations, not exact-byte evidence; keep exact archive identity unresolved. Any functional test must use an isolated disposable AD/DNS lab and synthetic SRV records.

sources.pageRequest: The web reader returned Cache miss; no product-page content was re-established.
sources.frozenInventoryObservation: The 2026-10-17 inventory records page version 1.00.0 versus version-list 01.00.00 dated 2002.02.17; the version-list row has no MD5/SHA-1 values.
sources.usageBehavior: ELDLLExInstall adds or removes an event source; the two-DLL design separates categories from messages and allows message IDs 1-99. Usage identifies ELDLLExInstall V01.00.00cpp, July 2004, and labels it freeware.
sources.disposition: Keep raw version/date observations separate. Exact archive members, required DLLs and installation/recovery behavior remain unverified; test registration and removal only in a disposable Windows target.
